headline: Congress renamed a Nashville, Tennessee post office building after former state legislator Thelma Harper.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2245 Rosa L Parks Boulevard in Nashville, Tennessee, the Thelma Harper Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 27, 2022.
